notes: All cooked meal packets should bear QR Code with details of Name of unit, FSSAI license no., Item name, Gramage etc. and date of packing and Veg/N.Veg. Sticker.
Pre-mix Tea/Coffee/Green Tea/Malt beverage should be served with Stirrer, disposable hard paper/corn starch cups, paper napkin & Hot Water in flask.
The menu should be served on cyclic basis.
Service of Morning Tea/Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner to be done in acrylic trays.
Service Evening Snacks to be preferably done in Snacks Box with co-branding of Vande Bharat Train.
All the packaging materials including disposable items may be as per color scheme of Vande Bharat Express with co-branding of IRCTC and Licensee.
Tray mat with Bi-lingual Menu/QR code to be used.
Hard ribbed disposable paper cups to be used for service of Beverages.
All food items should be individually packed & served in Coloured Teflon coated Aluminium Casseroles (60-70 micron) and Parathas should be packed/served in aluminum wrapper.
Malt beverages to be provided to Children instead of Tea/Coffee.
Option of Jain/ diabetic Food to be provided.
For the passengers of Executive class, the services will be through high quality crockery, cutlery, napkin etc.
